How to use it
  1. Pick a specimen. Some are cells, some are swimming!
  2. Start on the 4× lens (40× total). Always start small!
  3. Turn the focus until the picture is sharp.
  4. Move the slide to look around.
  5. Swimmers? Focus first, then tap one to find out its name.
  6. Get a sharp picture at 100× or 400× to unlock the discovery question.
  7. Record what you found in your notebook.
  8. Change to a stronger lens, then focus again.

1 · Select a specimen

2 · Choose an objective lens
